timeRules.rates: Zero denominator yields null, never zero or one
timeRules.gateMeaning: A starting threshold on submitted observations; never automatic G1-G4 approval

privacy.references: HMAC-SHA-256 truncated to 128 bits, pr_ prefix; keyed and namespace-separated
privacy.keyRotation: Keep a metric cohort on its registered reference-key version; rotating references without an authorized crosswalk breaks longitudinal denominators
privacy.consentAndSource: Retain consent and identifiable source material in its governed source system; analytics carries pseudonymous references only

metrics.numerator: First-use tests in report window with a usable first task and explicitly no assistance
metrics.denominator: All first-use tests in report window, including failures
metrics.notes: Assistance unknown is missing; do not substitute eventual success after coaching

metrics.numerator: Eligible report-window orders with observed usable finalized Proof
metrics.denominator: Every eligible order first eligible in report window
metrics.notes: Excluded orders require one enumerated exclusion reason; cancelled/failed eligible orders stay included

metrics.numerator: Usable orders from days 14 through 21 after enrollment
metrics.denominator: All eligible orders in the third week, only for merchants with 21 elapsed days
metrics.notes: Nonelapsed merchants shown separately; enrollment day is day zero

metrics.numerator: Elapsed eligible logical intents with durable receipt within 24 hours, inclusive
metrics.denominator: Eligible upload intents started in report window whose 24-hour window has elapsed
metrics.notes: Pending DB durability is not success; cancelled and failed intents remain; receipt after asOf is unavailable

metrics.numerator: All report-window starts with a durable receipt observed by asOf
metrics.denominator: All upload intents started in report window
metrics.notes: Includes eligibility exclusions and unelapsed windows; never replace eventual-commit denominator with this

metrics.numerator: PackProof tasks completed with fixed issue checklist passed
metrics.denominator: Every started PackProof task, including failed exports
metrics.notes: Null checklist is missing; failed tasks remain represented

metrics.numerator: PackProof tasks with confirmed actual file acceptance
metrics.notes: Acceptance, legibility, comprehension and improved handling are separate observations

metrics.numerator: Completed PackProof tasks with source-answer-key comprehension passed
metrics.notes: Unknown answers remain missing; reviewability does not imply endorsement

metrics.numerator: Qualified enrolled merchants with actual first payment by asOf
metrics.denominator: Qualified enrolled merchants whose predeclared payment decision window elapsed
metrics.notes: Dropouts stay in denominator; do not infer a payment from an active subscription UI

metrics.numerator: Elapsed second periods with actual payment within that period
metrics.denominator: First-period payers whose second period ended by asOf
metrics.notes: Payment is reported separately from use; unelapsed second periods are excluded visibly

metrics.numerator: Elapsed second periods with a usable eligible Proof finalized in that period
metrics.denominator: First-period payers whose second period ended by asOf
metrics.notes: A paid renewal without use is not retained use

metrics.numerator: Paired PackProof hands-on seconds minus matched ordinary-packing seconds
metrics.denominator: Every started paired task; incomplete/missing timings disclosed
metrics.notes: Unattended time reported separately; quantile uses linear interpolation; incomplete timings block passing gate

metrics.numerator: Ordinary median preparation seconds minus PackProof median seconds
metrics.notes: Completed timed tasks only for medians; all failed/incomplete tasks disclosed and block a passing timing gate

metrics.numerator: All support minutes including founder assistance
metrics.denominator: Weekly active merchants with a usable eligible finalized Proof
metrics.notes: Onboarding/ongoing and help for inactive merchants separate; compare a like-for-like earlier period to assess decline

usableProofChecklist: Issue-relevant item identifying details and condition readable
Required packing, seal and label views present or issue-specific gap disclosed
Durable preservation and required finalization verified
Provider omissions are labeled and assessed for the relevant issue

changeRequires: comparably recomputed old and new results
